description: Use when the user wants to define a new note schema/model with custom fields and card templates. Modifies the Anki collection structure — not for creating study content. Do not use when the user wants to create notes (use anki_create_note) or inspect an existing note type (use anki_get_note_type_info). Safety: confirm with the user before creating a new note type, as this changes the collection schema.
name: anki_create_note_type
title: Create Anki Note Type
